method.title: Methodology
method.lead: A forecast goes live before kickoff and stays in the open. It cannot be rewritten after the final whistle, so the numbers on the site are worth trusting.
method.publishBody: We do not publish everything we look at. A line first passes a strict numbers check. Perplexity then gathers the facts on the match, and Claude, GPT and Gemini each choose a pick on their own. The site shows the one they agree on.
method.mathBody: We strip the margin out of the price and compare it with our own estimate of the chance. Only lines with a real edge, a sensible price range and enough market offers move forward.
method.consensusBody: Perplexity (Perplexity AI) Pro Search is a next-generation search engine and a smart AI assistant. It works as a hybrid of a search engine and a neural network: it searches the web and writes the answer itself. For us it looks only for match facts: injuries, suspensions, the expected lineup, players left out, recent words from the coach, the last five games, and what the fixture is still worth. Rumors without a source do not get in, and it does not name a winner. Models: Claude, GPT and Gemini each read that brief on their own. A forecast is published when 2 of 3 models agree with the prediction. If they do not, we do not guess: the match stays in the public record as a pass, not as a hidden miss.
method.lockBody: Once the match starts, no new forecast can appear. Every publication carries a digital fingerprint: the event, the pick, the price and the exact time. A published row cannot be edited or deleted.
method.settleBody: When the match ends, we check the forecast against the score. Wins, losses and refunds stay in the archive. Postponements and cancellations stay visible too. The history is not cleaned up.
method.statsBody: The home page shows the current series, in full. A new series does not erase the past: older forecasts leave the public total and do not disappear. Two simple checks sit beside our result: math only, and always the favorite. The difference is easy to see.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Leagues, markets, region, value thresholds and both LLM tracks. Totals ranges are separate for football, the Euroleague, the NBA and tennis.
settings.leaguesDescription: Clear a league to keep it out of odds requests.
settings.marketsDescription: An /odds request for moneyline, totals and handicap in the eu region costs 3 credits. If the month's required requests do not fit, the handicap is dropped from the request first.
settings.regionHint: eu by default, because Pinnacle is quoted there.
settings.thresholdsDescription: A candidate passes when EV is above the threshold. An outcome with EV from 0 up to the threshold is kept as a near miss and stays out of the public stats. The threshold can be lowered to 0%.
settings.modelDescription: This value is kept in settings. The Value track does not call it and does not publish a forecast.
settings.reserveHint: Odds requests stop when they would leave less than the reserve.
settings.testRunsHint: At most one run every 5 minutes. The day resets at 00:00 UTC.
settings.webSearch: Web search for final candidates only
settings.webSearchLimitHint: The day resets at 00:00 UTC. Search is used by the AI-pick researcher.
settings.aiPickDescription: The only published track. Three models from different providers vote independently, and a forecast is kept only when they agree. When the monthly budget is spent, publication stops.
settings.researchModelHint: It does not vote. Leave empty to let the first voting model search.
settings.toleranceHint: The average probability must be at least 1 / price minus this tolerance.
settings.aiPickMinEvHint: A negative value only drops outcomes that are clearly expensive. Default is −3.
settings.shortlistHint: At most this many events per day, ranked by EV.
settings.aiPickBudgetHint: Counts search and votes. Value checks are outside this limit.

test.title: Chain check
test.description: Odds request, the mathematical model and the AI-pick vote. Nothing is written to predictions, the public site or Telegram.
test.noLeagues: No leagues are enabled. Turn one on in settings.
test.mocked: Preview or mock mode: The Odds API is not called and no credits are spent.
test.noModelRows: There is nothing to score in these prices.
test.consensusYes: The models agreed. The forecast is not written to the predictions table.
test.consensusNo: There is no agreement. The event stays filtered by consensus.
test.matchesFavorite: The selection matches the market favourite.
test.notPublished: The test does not publish a forecast and does not change the stats.
test.value_cap: The Value check runs for at most three candidate events.
test.no_value_candidates: There are no Value candidates, so that model was not called.
test.ai_pick_disabled: The AI-pick track is turned off in settings.
test.ai_pick_budget: The AI-pick monthly budget is spent, so the vote was skipped.
test.ai_pick_cap: The test votes on one shortlisted event.
test.no_shortlist: No event reached the AI-pick shortlist.
test.web_search_limited: The daily web-search limit is used up, so later requests run without search.
test.missing_openrouter_key: The OpenRouter key is missing, so the LLM blocks were skipped.
